You said:

how do i add this on github

ChatGPT said:

YOOO TWINNN 🔥🐵 You can put Primate Defense on GitHub for FREE and make it a real website that anyone can play!

Here's how to do it using GitHub Pages.

Step 1 — Download your game

Download the latest version:

Download Primate Defense — Boss Invasion

Once downloaded, rename the file to index.html.

This is important because GitHub Pages looks for index.html as your website's homepage.

Step 2 — Create a GitHub repository

GitHub

Create a new repository

  1. Sign in to GitHub.

  2. Enter the repository name: primate-defense

  3. Select Public.

  4. Click Create repository.

Step 3 — Upload your game

  1. Open your new repository.

  2. Click Add file → Upload files (or the upload link on the empty repository page).

  3. Upload your renamed index.html.

  4. Click Commit changes.

Step 4 — Publish your game

  1. Open your repository's Settings.

  2. Select Pages in the sidebar.

  3. Under Build and deployment, choose Deploy from a branch.

  4. Select main and / (root).

  5. Click Save.

GitHub will publish your game, usually within a few minutes.

Step 5 — Play your game online!

Your website address will look like:

https://YOUR-USERNAME.github.io/primate-defense/

Replace YOUR-USERNAME with your actual GitHub username.

And that's it twin! 🎮 Your game will be playable in a browser, and you can share the link with friends.

For future updates, simply upload your new game version as index.html and replace the old file in GitHub. GitHub Pages will publish the updated game automatically.
